def cholesky_decomposition(input_matrix):
    rows = len(input_matrix)
    cols = len(input_matrix[0])

    # Allocate matrix
    matrix = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(rows, cols)
    perm = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc(rows)

    # Fill the matrix with input values
    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):
            value = input_matrix[i][j]
            gsl.gsl_matrix_set(matrix, i, j, value)

    # Call the decomposition function
    status = gsl.gsl_linalg_pcholesky_decomp(matrix, ctypes.c_size_t(rows), ctypes.c_size_t(cols))

    if status != 0:
        raise ValueError(f"GSL decomposition failed with status {status}")

    # Extract the results
    result_matrix = [[0.0 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    for i in range(rows):
        for j in range(cols):
            result_matrix[i][j] = gsl.gsl_matrix_get(matrix, i, j)

    permutation = [0 for _ in range(rows)]
    for i in range(rows):
        permutation[i] = gsl.gsl_permutation_get(perm, i)

    # Free memory
    gsl.gsl_matrix_free(matrix)
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free(perm)

    return (result_matrix, permutation)
